Clawed.description: Blessed with exceptionally sharp, retractable claws.

features.name: Clawed Catfolk
features.tldr: You have sharp claws that deal slashing damage for unarmed attacks.

NineLives.description: Possessing uncanny agility and a knack for avoiding fatal disasters.

features.name: Nine Lives Catfolk
features.tldr: You bounce back from falls and minor missteps with miraculous ease.
